title: Compatible affine numerators with a common positive denominator
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $I$ a quasi-coherent finite-type $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and $\iota:I\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ a monomorphism [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $U$ be an open such that $x\in U$ iff $\iota_x$ is surjective [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. Let $F$ be quasi-coherent, $V$ affine, and $s\in F(U)$. There are $t\geq0$, $k>0$, $g:\operatorname{Fin}(t)\to R=\mathcal O_X(V)$, and $x_i\in F(V)$ such that $\operatorname{im}(\iota(V))=(g_i\mid i<t)$, $U\cap V=\bigcup_{i<t}D_V(g_i)$, and $g_j^k x_i=g_i^k x_j$ for all $i,j<t$. Moreover, on every open $W\subseteq U\cap V\cap D_V(g_i)$, one has $(g_i|_W)^k(s|_W)=x_i|_W$.

source.place: Lemma 01PM (lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open-in-affine), proof, denominator construction; Lemma 01PQ (lemma-sections-over-quasi-compact-open), affine reduction. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PM and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01PQ.

proof.text: Use the finite-generator cover. For each i, express the restriction of s to D(g_i) as a localized section with numerator m_i and exponent e_i. Take l=max_i(e_i)+1 and multiply m_i by g_i^(l-e_i) to obtain y_i. Restriction and the equality l-e_i+e_i=l show g_i^l*s=y_i on all smaller opens.

On D(g_i*g_j), the difference g_j^l*y_i-g_i^l*y_j restricts to zero, by substituting the fraction identities and commuting scalars. Localization gives a power a_ij of g_i*g_j killing that difference. Set d=max_ij(a_ij). Then k=l+d and x_i=g_i^d*y_i give exact cross relations in F(V); the same restriction calculation preserves the fraction identities. Finite maxima of empty families are zero, so t=0 and an empty chart are included.

theorem affine_compatible_denominator_data
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : X.Modules}
    (ι : I ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) [Mono ι]
    [I.IsQuasicoherent] [I.IsFiniteType]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ x : X, x ∈ U ↔ Function.Surjective
      ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace x).map ι).hom)
    (V : X.affineOpens) (s : Γ(F, U)) :
    ∃ (t k : ℕ) (g : Fin t → Γ(X, V.1)) (x : Fin t → Γ(F, V.1)),
      0 < k ∧
      (LinearMap.range (ι.val.app (op V.1)).hom : Ideal Γ(X, V.1)) =
        Ideal.span (Set.range g) ∧
      U ⊓ V.1 = ⨆ i, X.basicOpen (g i) ∧
      (∀ i j, g j ^ k • x i = g i ^ k • x j) ∧
      ∀ (i : Fin t) (W : X.Opens) (hWU : W ≤ U) (hWV : W ≤ V.1),
        W ≤ X.basicOpen (g i) →
        X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op (g i ^ k) •
          F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWU).op s =
            F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op (x i)
